entries.title: Keep sprite clips at one body scale and tidy studio and start-menu UI
entries.body: Animation clips are packed against their still image, so switching clips (idle to dash) no longer resizes the character. Each frame is matched to the still's body area, cells get a transparent gutter, and stray grid lines and slivers are removed. Clips use 512 px cells. Existing projects are repacked locally, from their original drawing, when a game is opened, exported or edited. dash and slide play once and hold their last pose. fit() and body() size the standing character. HUD icons render ima

entries.title: Draw 2D sprites for side, front, rear, top-down, or isometric
Show a What's new window rebuilt on every deploy
Require every stage to deliver the full game and let QA check it
Code agent: medium effort and retry without thinking when output budget runs out
Fix usage cost estimates and give code agent 128K output
Handle OpenAI safety rejections on spritesheets
Detect truncated director JSON and enforce visible input limits
Version asset file URLs so the studio and game never show a stale cached file.
entries.body: Files are served immutable; a ?v=updatedAt query makes a replaced file (e.g. a renumbered spritesheet revision) load fresh instead of reusing the old cached image. Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

entries.title: Add 2D animation spritesheets generated by the artist pipeline.
entries.body: Characters in 2D games get a frame spritesheet drawn from their approved sprite (OpenAI edit with reference), normalized to a strict grid with a shared baseline, QA'd per frame (empty, hollow, scale, walk leg variation) and played by forge.phaser.animate, with a runtime safety net for sprites the game never animated. Each sheet revision keeps its own frame layout so older revisions stay usable. Also fixes dark-sprite keying (hollow silhouettes + QA), the viewer checkerboard, and voice regen keep

entries.title: Add official landing at / and move the studio to /studio.
entries.body: Localized ES/EN/FR landing with real product screenshots and a reproducible capture script, a 3D Forgy intro mascot framed to its bounding sphere, and fixes for library thumbnails, the play header overlap, and Forge Pro node labels. Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

entries.title: Add Tripo auto-rig/retarget and a runtime skeletal animator.
entries.body: Supports biped and quadruped clips, locks root-motion bones, and grounds skinned GLBs so characters stay on their gameplay root. Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

entries.title: Harden Tripo text-to-3D flow and mesh character studio UX.
entries.body: Prefer text-to-model for new games, DoubleSide/yaw fixes in the Three host, and hide provider chips behind a debug toggle with language controls top-right. Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

entries.title: Polish studio play UX: locale chrome, cinematic subtitles, and busy overlay.
entries.body: Keep start menu when maximizing, localize overlay copy to the studio language, strip voice-prompt leakage, and tighten pause/settings layout. Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

entries.title: Add silent cinematic director for unique in-engine intros.
entries.body: Plans camera/staging shots per game design (not a loader stage or video file), wires them into create + runtime onCinematic/forge.cinematic so intros match genre and art instead of a static frame. Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

entries.title: Ship i18n, mesh characters, and studio polish for Forge Xpresso.
entries.body: Adds ES/EN/FR UI and play runtime strings, 3D character/primitives fallback without Tripo, cutout prop prompts, asset hot-swap revisions, and related director/code/runtime hardening—excluding generated project data. Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
